skeleton.authorship: NEW MU213 spell-local unrated chassis; not a bestiary entry or Wizard class minion
skeleton.checks: listed raw ability modifier only; no proficiency

attack.name: bone strike
attack.requires: one retained usable load-bearing limb or comparable actual striking appendage

skeleton.body: Retain actual donor material, mass, size, dimensions, pose and missing parts. No larger/smaller HP or damage scaling.
skeleton.senses: ordinary sight/hearing only where corresponding actual anatomy survives; no darkvision, blindsight or owner-sense link
skeleton.needs: NEW source animation sustains movement without breathing, food or sleep while active; no biological restoration and no natural rest healing. This is not a grant of poison/disease immunity.
skeleton.anatomy: No usable locomotor anatomy means Speed0. No usable striking appendage means no Strike. Hands/gripping require real retained appendages. No rebuilt head/limb, grown weapon or ammunition.
skeleton.carrying: Use BODY_EQUIPMENT actual size/STR and physical grip/support; no free cargo/proficiency. No gear appears at creation.
skeleton.perPhase: one movement budget and at most one authorized Action; no Bonus Action or Reaction/Opportunity Attack; no separate regular turn
skeleton.damageLifecycle: HP-only; no Wounds/death saves/rest replenishment for this chassis. Ordinary0 ends that animation; source-qualified Null0 disables same active identity.
skeleton.healing: Only an actual healing/repair source whose exact target includes this undead animation can raise normalHP. No healing permission supplied by the profile; living/dying-only recovery cannot be assumed.
